scope: Cancel active cloud task without waiting for the cloud queue mutex
finding: cloud_task_submit held the queue mutex through remote submission, polling and result retrieval. cloud_task_cancel attempted to acquire that mutex before it could cancel, so cancellation could not interrupt an active remote status wait.
change: AppState now keeps per-task watch senders separate from the queue lock. The cancel endpoint signals first. CloudTaskQueue::run_next_with_cancel selects on cancellation during status polling, retry backoff, result retrieval and fetch backoff, then invokes remote cancel, persists Canceled and emits one terminal event. Repeated cancel is idempotent.
regression_test_source: pending remote status is interrupted within a bounded test deadline
Canceled state is persisted to the task JSON
exactly one Canceled progress event is emitted

rust_tests.required: at least 6 GB available and memory use strictly below 80%
rust_tests.result: resource_limited: Invoke-CiCargo rejected before Cargo launch; required at least 6 GB available and memory use below 80%.

limitations: The queue mutex still blocks concurrent GET status/result requests, and the submit endpoint returns only after execution. A queue actor and immediate task acknowledgement remain unimplemented. No Rust type check or test execution has verified this change.
